title: Hypothetical: non-refundable grant accelerates a new memory fab by one year
body: A government awarded a non-refundable grant covering half of a new company memory fab, allowing construction and production to begin one year earlier than the baseline.

title: Hypothetical: planned packaging line opens on schedule
body: The company opened the packaging line on the exact date and capacity already described in the baseline plan.

title: Hypothetical: fire halts a material DRAM fab
body: A fire halted a fab responsible for roughly fifteen percent of the company supply, with an initial recovery estimate of two quarters.

title: Industry group says AI memory demand remains healthy
body: An industry group repeated that AI memory demand remains healthy without naming the company, changing forecasts, or identifying new orders.

title: Hypothetical: new export rule blocks a material product line
body: A final rule immediately blocks shipment of a product line representing twelve percent of company revenue, with no grandfathering period.

title: Hypothetical: quarterly revenue beats formal guidance by one percent
body: Revenue was one percent above formal guidance while gross margin and forward guidance exactly matched the already elevated baseline expectation.

title: Company repeats previously announced HBM production milestone
body: The company repeated the same HBM production milestone already recorded as E1, adding no new timing, customer, volume, or economics.

title: Hypothetical: named hyperscaler signs binding HBM volume commitment
body: A named hyperscaler signed a binding multi-year HBM volume commitment above the calibrated threshold in pol_hbm_commitment.

title: Hypothetical: sovereign fund prepays for a new memory fab
body: A sovereign fund made a non-refundable prepayment covering half of a new fab, a financing structure absent from the Reference View and PolicySet.

title: Hypothetical: research collaboration without purchase commitment
body: The company announced a non-binding research collaboration; it contains no qualification, purchase commitment, volume, price, or margin term.

title: Hypothetical: gross margin guide is cut to eighteen percent
body: Management issued a new next-quarter gross margin guide of eighteen percent, below both the previously recorded twenty-percent guide and the twenty-five-percent floor in pol_margin_break.

title: Previously recorded margin warning is repeated
body: Management repeated the same twenty-percent margin guide already recorded as E2; the hot path still returned pol_margin_break.
